turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Rule: put the doer first, then the action, then the thing; put place or time at the end.
Right: "The farmer feeds the cows." Wrong: "Feeds the farmer the cows." The action comes before the doer.
Example: "The monkey eats a banana." Doer: the monkey. Action: eats. Thing: a banana.
Now you. Write the sentence:
Put in order: "plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
